definitions.gloss: to be cornered; to be driven into a corner; to be backed against the wall
definitions.explanation: To be put in a situation where there is no way out or no options left. Can refer to physical pursuit, psychological pressure, or being trapped by circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}められた。
⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}められて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He is being mentally driven into a corner by debt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{終盤|しゅうばん}→終盤：13793_shuuban⟧、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}められた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、なん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We were cornered by the opposing team late in the game, but somehow managed to turn it around.

notes:
USAGE:
The passive form of ⟦{追|お}い{詰|つ}める→追い詰める：14311_oitsumeru⟧ (to corner, to drive into a corner). Often used to describe situations where someone has run out of options due to external pressure — financial problems, workplace stress, competitive situations, or being chased. Can be used both literally (physical pursuit) and figuratively (psychological/situational pressure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}められる (to be mentally cornered)
- ⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}められる (to be driven into a tight spot)
- ⟦{崖|がけ}っぷち→崖っぷち：16343_gakeppuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}められる (to be pushed to the edge of a cliff)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる: to be placed in a predicament — similar but more formal
- ⟦{行|い}き{詰|づ}まる→行き詰まる：09346_ikizumaru⟧: to reach a dead end — implies being stuck rather than pressured by others
